title: Mode 1: Creating a Loss Function and Optimizer

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we created another model.
cues.zh: 上一部影片，我們建立另一個模型。

cues.en: So we're continuing with our modeling experiments.
cues.zh: 所以繼續進行建模實驗。

cues.en: And the only difference here between fashion model V one and V zero is that we've added in nonlinear layers.
cues.zh: FashionMNISTModelV1 與 V0 唯一差異，就是加入非線性層。

cues.en: Now, we don't know for now we could think or guess whether they would help improve our model.
cues.zh: 目前不知道效果，只能推測或猜它們會不會改善模型。

cues.en: And with practice, you can start to understand how different functions will influence your neural networks.
cues.zh: 練習之後，就會開始了解不同函數如何影響神經網路。

cues.en: But I prefer to evened out, code it out, run lots of different experiments.
cues.zh: 不過我更喜歡有疑問就寫程式，做許多不同實驗。

cues.en: So let's continue.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: We now have to create a loss function, loss optimizer and evaluation matrix.
cues.zh: 現在要建立損失函數、最佳化器與評估指標。

cues.en: So we've done this for model zero, so we're not going to spend too much time explaining what's going on here.
cues.zh: model_0 已經做過，所以不花太多時間解釋。

cues.en: And we've done this a fair few times now.
cues.zh: 目前已經做過好幾次。

cues.en: So from helper functions, which is the script we downloaded before, we're going to import our accuracy function and we're going to set up a loss function, which is we're working with multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 從之前下載的 helper_functions 腳本，匯入 accuracy_fn，再設定損失函數；我們處理的是多類別分類。

cues.en: So what loss function do we typically use and then cross entropy loss.
cues.zh: 通常使用什麼損失？nn.CrossEntropyLoss。

cues.en: And as our optimizer is going to be taught optim SGD and we're going to optimize this time, I'll put
cues.zh: 最佳化器是 torch.optim.SGD，這次要最佳化，我把

cues.en: in the params keyword here, model one dot parameters and the learning rate.
cues.zh: params 關鍵字寫在這裡，model_1.parameters()，再來 learning rate。

cues.en: We're just going to keep it the same as our previous model.
cues.zh: 與之前的模型保持相同。

cues.en: And that's the thing to keep a note for your experiments.
cues.zh: 這也是實驗要記住的一點。

cues.en: When you're running fair few experiments, you only really want to tweak a couple of things or maybe just one thing per experiment.
cues.zh: 做許多實驗時，每次最好只調幾件事，或者只改一件。

cues.en: That way you can really narrow down what actually influences your model and what improves it, slash what doesn't improve it.
cues.zh: 這樣才能縮小範圍，知道到底什麼影響模型、什麼能改善，什麼不能。

cues.en: And a little pop quiz.
cues.zh: 來個小測驗。

cues.en: What does the loss function do?
cues.zh: 損失函數做什麼？

cues.en: This is going to measure how wrong our model is.
cues.zh: 衡量模型有多不準。

cues.en: And what does the optimizer do?
cues.zh: 最佳化器做什麼？

cues.en: Tries to update our model's parameters to reduce the loss.
cues.zh: 試著更新模型參數，降低損失。

cues.en: That's what these two functions are going to be doing.
cues.zh: 這就是這兩個函數要做的事。

cues.en: The accuracy function is, of course, going to be measuring our model's accuracy.
cues.zh: accuracy_fn 當然是衡量模型準確率。

cues.en: We measure the accuracy because that's one of the base classification metrics.
cues.zh: 要衡量準確率，因為這是基本分類指標之一。

cues.en: So we'll run this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: What's next?
cues.zh: 接下來？

cues.en: We're getting quite good at this.
cues.zh: 我們已經相當熟練。

cues.en: We've picked a lost function and an optimizer.
cues.zh: 選好損失函數與最佳化器。

cues.en: Now we're going to build a training loop.
cues.zh: 現在建立訓練迴圈。

cues.en: However, we spend quite a bit of time doing that in a previous video.
cues.zh: 不過前一部影片已花很多時間做這件事。

cues.en: If we go up here, that was our VAL model function.
cues.zh: 到上面，這是 eval_model 函式。

cues.en: Oh, that was helpful.
cues.zh: 喔，很有幫助。

cues.en: We turned it into a function.
cues.zh: 已經包成函式。

cues.en: How about we do the same with these?
cues.zh: 這些也這麼做，如何？

cues.en: Why don't we make a function for our training loop as well as our testing loop?
cues.zh: 為訓練迴圈與測試迴圈各建立函式吧。

cues.en: So I think you can give this a go.
cues.zh: 我想你可以先試試。

cues.en: We're going to make a function in the next video for training.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，要建立訓練函式。

cues.en: We're going to call that train step and we'll create a function for testing called test step.
cues.zh: 叫作 train_step，再建立測試函式 test_step。

cues.en: Now, they'll both have to take in some parameters.
cues.zh: 兩者都需要接收一些參數。

cues.en: I'll let you figure out what they are.
cues.zh: 讓你想想是哪些。

cues.en: But otherwise, we're going to code that up together in the next video.
cues.zh: 不然下一部影片會一起寫。

cues.en: So I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
